'''MF-80''' was [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder's]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] went to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in order to talk to the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]], MF-80 was present and translated the conversation between her master and the two Jedi. Her metal plating had a two-color scheme.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
MF-80 was voiced by [[Angelique Perrin]], who also portrayed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Mama/Legends|Mama]] the Hutt in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] TV series. She replaced TC-70, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desijilic Tiure's]] protocol droid, who was originally intended to appear.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/hunt-for-ziro-trivia-gallery|text="Hunt for Ziro" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref>
